Word 转 JSON——离线、有表才成数组、多表会分组Word to JSON offline — tables, grouping, no guesswork

这条链的产出形状完全由文档里**有几张表**决定，这是它最容易被讲反的地方。`docx>html` 先由 mammoth 把文档体还原成语义 HTML（标题层级、列表、表格；内嵌图片读成 data URI；脚注会作为末尾列表进来、插入修订按正文读出、文本框内容照常成段，只有批注不落），`html>json` 再按三条分支取数：`doc.querySelectorAll` 取 `table` **只有一张**时，产出对象数组——第一行当表头、其余行按表头配成键值；**两张及以上**时，产出**按文档顺序分组的对象**，分组名取同级的小标题（`h2`），标题不够用就回落成 `Sheet2` 这类名字；**一张表都没有**时，退一步去读文档里第一个 `<pre>`（或 `<code>`）的文本再 `JSON.parse`——注意这一步取的是 `textContent`，所以用 `<br>` 排的换行在这里会消失，两条路都不成立就明确报 `errors.htmlToJson` 而不是给你一个空数组。有一条重要的下游连带后果要写在这：多张表产出的**不是数组**，所以再往「只吃数组」的步骤走（`json>csv`、`csv>xlsx`）会在下一步报错「JSON 内容必须是包含数据的数组才能转换为 CSV」——**要一次交付多张表，就该走 Word→Excel 之类不经过那道闸的路线，或者干脆把文档拆成每张表单独转**。取值也有边界：mammoth 读的是文档里存下的文字，公式与格式不是它的取数范围；表头里重复或为空的格子会互相覆盖（后者赢），跨 `colspan` 的表头只算一格。全程只有 storage 权限，不联网。The shape of the output on this chain is decided entirely by **how many tables the document holds**, and that is where it most often gets explained backwards. `docx>html` first has mammoth restore the body as semantic HTML (heading levels, lists, tables; embedded pictures become data URIs; footnotes arrive as a trailing list, tracked insertions read as body text and text-box content becomes paragraphs — only comments are left out), and `html>json` then takes one of three branches: with **exactly one** `doc.querySelectorAll` 取 `table` hit it produces an array of objects, first row as headers and the rest zipped against them; with **two or more** it produces an **object grouped in document order**, naming each group after the heading at the same level (`h2`), falling back to names like `Sheet2` when there are not enough; with **no table at all** it reads the first `<pre>` (or `<code>`) text and runs `JSON.parse` — and since that step takes `textContent`, line breaks made with `<br>` disappear here — and when neither works it fails with `errors.htmlToJson` rather than handing you an empty array. One downstream consequence belongs on this page: several tables produce **not an array**, so the next step if that step only accepts arrays (`json>csv`, then `csv>xlsx`) refuses with «JSON content must be an array of objects to convert to CSV». **To deliver several sheets at once, take a route that does not pass that gate, or convert one table at a time.** The value boundary is stated too: mammoth reads the words stored in the document, so formulas and formatting are outside what it fetches; duplicate or empty header cells overwrite each other (the later one wins), and a header spanning `colspan` counts as one key. All of it on the storage permission, with no network.

共 2 步，由扩展的路径搜索自动选出，中间产物不落盘。2 steps, chosen by the extension's own path search; intermediate results never touch the disk.

会保留什么What carries over

  • 一张表就是对象数组：第一行当表头、其余行按键配对，顺序保持文档原样One table becomes an array of objects: the first row as headers, the rest zipped against them, in document order
  • 多张表按文档顺序分组，键取同级 `h2`；标题不够时回落成 `Sheet2` 这类名字Several tables group in document order, keyed by the sibling `h2`; unnamed groups fall back to `Sheet2`-style names
  • 没有表格时退到第一个 `<pre>` / `<code>` 的文本再解析，解析不了就明确报错With no table it falls back to the first `<pre>` / `<code>` text and parses that, and fails clearly when parsing cannot work
  • 标题层级与正文文字都按语义还原（`h1`–`h4`、列表、表格），不是把文档压成一坨文本Heading levels and body text are restored semantically (`h1`–`h4`, lists, tables) rather than flattened into one blob
  • 一批最多 200 个文件、单个 100 MB，与其他路线共用同一道闸门Up to 200 files per batch and 100 MB each — the same gate every other route shares

如实说明的限制What it does not do

  • 多张表产出的是分组对象而不是数组，所以接「只吃数组」的下一步（`json>csv`、`csv>xlsx`）会报错——那张路要走 Word→Excel，或一张表转一次Several tables yield a grouped object, not an array, so the next step refuses if it only accepts arrays (`json>csv`, `csv>xlsx`) — take Word to Excel for that, or convert one table at a time
  • 读的是文档里存下的文字：公式的值与单元格格式不在取数范围，条件格式更不是It reads the words stored in the document: cell formula results and formatting are outside what it fetches, and conditional formatting even more so
  • 表头里重复或为空的格子会互相覆盖（后者赢），跨 `colspan` 的表头只算一个键Duplicate or empty header cells overwrite each other (the later wins), and a header spanning `colspan` counts as a single key
  • 用 `<br>` 排的换行在退读代码块那一步会消失（取的是 `textContent`）Line breaks made with `<br>` vanish in the code-block fallback, which reads `textContent`
  • 脚注会以 `[1]` 这样的引用留在文字里；批注不进、`w:ins` 按正文读出Footnote references stay in the text as `[1]`-style marks; comments do not come across and `w:ins` reads as body text

实操提示Working with it

  • 要一份表格 CSV / Excel：一张表时用 Word→CSV 或 Word→Excel，多张表请拆开或走 Word→HTML 自己取For CSV or Excel from a table: use Word to CSV / Excel when there is one table; split several, or take Word to HTML and pick them apart
  • 要纯文字：Word→TXT 丢掉表格结构，但正文读得更完整For plain words: Word to TXT drops the table structure but reads the body more completely
  • 要能再编辑的网页或文档：Word→HTML / Word→Markdown，那里表格会带 colspan 信息进标记For an editable page or document: Word to HTML / Markdown keeps `colspan` in the markup

常见问题Questions people actually ask

为什么转出来是一个对象而不是数组？Why did I get an object instead of an array?

因为文档里有两张以上的表（表格套在单元格里也算两张，取表用的是会下钻的选择器）。这条路会按文档顺序把它们分组，组名取同级小标题、缺标题时用 `SheetN`。这是刻意保留「哪张表是哪个」的信息，代价就是产物不再是数组——所以紧接着走「只吃数组」的那步会报错。要么一次转一张表，要么改走 Word→Excel 那条不经过这道闸的链。Because the document held more than one table (a table nested inside a cell counts too, since the selector descends). The route groups them in document order, naming each group after its heading or falling back to `SheetN`. Keeping «which table is which» is deliberate, and the price is that the artifact is no longer an array — which is exactly what the next arrays-only step complains about. Convert one table at a time, or take Word to Excel, which does not pass that gate.

我的 Word 里没有表格，转 JSON 会怎样？What if my Word file has no tables?

取表那一步失败后会退到「读第一个 `<pre>` / `<code>` 的文本再解析 JSON」，也就是说文档里得有形如 JSON 的代码块才行；正文段落不会被猜成数据。两条都不成立就明确报 `errors.htmlToJson`，不会给你一份空数组冒充成功。要的是文字，请走 Word→TXT / Markdown。After the table branch misses, it falls back to reading the first `<pre>` / `<code>` text and parsing it as JSON, so the document needs a code block that really contains JSON; ordinary paragraphs are not guessed into data. If neither works it fails with `errors.htmlToJson` rather than passing off an empty array as success. If what you want is words, take Word to TXT or Markdown.

表头那一行会怎么处理？How is the header row handled?

一张表的场合取第一行当键名、其余行配成对象。三个细节值得知道：表头里出现重复或为空的格子，后写的会盖掉先写的；跨 `colspan` 的表头只算一个键；某一行格子比表头多时，多出的部分是在取表这一步就被丢掉的（不是后面转 CSV 时丢的）。要参与运算的值请在 Word 里算完再转——公式不会被重新求值。With a single table, the first row supplies the keys and the rest become objects. Three details matter: repeated or empty header cells let the later one win, a header spanning `colspan` counts as one key, and when a row carries more cells than the header, the extras are dropped right here at the table-reading step (not later, converting to CSV). Values that must be computed belong in Word first — formulas are never re-evaluated.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
